Implements the v2 design from docs/emet-architecture-v2-design.md \u00a74 & \u00a75. ## How it works 1. **Register**: A watchtower stakes a small registration bond (REGISTRATION_BOND).    This prevents spam \u2014 flagging costs reputation. 2. **Flag**: A watchtower calls `flag(claimId, evidence)` to signal a discrepancy    between a staked claim and its observed outcome. The flag is recorded on-chain. 3. **Dynamic challenge bond**: Any challenger calling `getChallengeBond(claimId)`    gets a bond price computed as:      bond = BASE_BOND             \u00d7 timeMultiplier(elapsed)    \u2014 older claims are harder to challenge             \u00d7 stakeMultiplier(stakeAmt)  \u2014 bigger stakes attract more scrutiny             \u00d7 consensusDiscount(flags)   \u2014 more flags = cheaper (consensus forming) 4. **Slash split (v2)**: When a challenge succeeds:      - Primary challenger: 50% of slash      - Watchtower (if a valid flag exists): 20% of slash      - Treasury: 30% of slash 5. **False flag penalty**: If a watchtower's flag is repeatedly not followed by a    successful challenge (MISSED_FLAG_LIMIT), their bond is slashed and they are    deregistered.","version":1}},"settings":{"compilationTarget":{"src/EMETWatchtower.sol":"EMETWatchtower"},"evmVersion":"cancun","libraries":{},"metadata":{"bytecodeHash":"ipfs"},"optimizer":{"enabled":true,"runs":200},"remappings":[":forge-std/=lib/forge-std/src/"]},"sources":{"src/EMETWatchtower.sol":{"keccak256":"0x6e90554503eae657389c92910045fc667fe55366184155d2c933b8585cac1cfb","license":"MIT","urls":["bzz-raw://25ef2f0646a004d2abe03c76f1fa12fc4ba7492485eb55d49645d9341c5648e2","dweb:/ipfs/QmeAjcbNkuYYryToV31WoKtZpLwTco62mdGZ5HSedQCedw"]}},"version":1}

returns.treasuryShare: Amount to treasury (30%, adjusted if no watchtower)
returns.watchtowerShare: Amount to watchtower (20%), or 0 if no valid flag

params.evidence: keccak256 hash of off-chain evidence (IPFS CID, oracle proof, etc.)

getChallengeBond(uint256).details: All multipliers are in basis points (10000 = 1×). Final price = product/10000^2.      Max bond is capped at 10× BASE_BOND to avoid prohibitive costs.

params.slashAmount: Total slash amount (if success); 0 if dismissed
params.slashSuccess: true = slash succeeded (watchtower earns bounty); false = dismissed

BASE_BOND().notice: Base challenge bond before any multipliers (in wei)

CHALLENGER_SHARE_BPS().notice: Fraction of slash going to primary challenger (basis points, 5000 = 50%)

MISSED_FLAG_LIMIT().notice: Number of stale flags (no successful challenge) before bond is slashed

REGISTRATION_BOND().notice: Bond required to register as a watchtower (in wei)

TREASURY_SHARE_BPS().notice: Fraction of slash going to treasury (basis points, 3000 = 30%)

WATCHTOWER_SHARE_BPS().notice: Fraction of slash going to the flagging watchtower (basis points, 2000 = 20%)

claimStake(uint256).notice: claimId → stake amount (set by the claim author; used for repricing)

claimTimestamp(uint256).notice: claimId → timestamp the claim was submitted

computeSlashSplit(uint256,bool).notice: Compute the slash split for a given amount.

deregister().notice: Voluntarily deregister and recover your bond (only if no unresolved flags).

flag(uint256,bytes32).notice: Flag a claim as potentially false. Only registered watchtowers.

flagCount(uint256).notice: Number of flags on a given claim.

flags(uint256,uint256).notice: claimId → list of flags submitted by watchtowers

getChallengeBond(uint256).notice: Compute the challenge bond for a given claimId.         bond = BASE_BOND × timeMultiplier × stakeMultiplier × consensusDiscount

getFlag(uint256,uint256).notice: Get info about a specific flag.

hasActiveFlag(uint256).notice: Check if any active (unresolved) flag exists for a claim.

owner().notice: owner address (can set treasury, record claims)

recordClaim(uint256,uint256).notice: Record that a new claim was staked. Owner-only (called by protocol).

register().notice: Register as a watchtower. Caller must send exactly REGISTRATION_BOND.

resolveFlag(uint256,uint256,bool,uint256.notice: Resolve a flag after a challenge outcome is known.         Owner-only (called by the main challenge contract after resolution).

treasury().notice: treasury address for collecting the treasury share
